# TechTerms.com

> > A comprehensive computer dictionary and technology reference with 1,500+ definitions covering AI, hardware, software, internet standards, and modern tech terminology.

TechTerms.com serves as an authoritative online glossary for technology professionals, students, and enthusiasts seeking clear explanations of computing concepts. The site combines reference definitions with interactive quizzes and learning resources across hardware, software, AI, security, and internet infrastructure topics.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models (LLM)
- Generative AI
- ChatGPT
- Microsoft Copilot
- Small Language Models (SLM)
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Hyper-Threading
- WebP Image Format
- CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures)
- System Hardening
- Internet Standards
- XLR Connectors
- Managed Service Providers (MSP)
- IANA (Internet Assigned Numbers Authority)
- macOS User Accounts

## AI & Language Models

- [LLM Definition - What is an LLM (Large Language Model)?](https://techterms.com/definition/llm): Definition of Large Language Models including ChatGPT and how they work
- [SLM Definition - What is an SLM (Small Language Model)?](https://techterms.com/definition/slm): Explanation of Small Language Models and comparison to Large Language Models
- [Copilot Definition - What is Microsoft Copilot?](https://techterms.com/definition/copilot): Overview of Microsoft Copilot AI assistant and underlying GPT-4 technology
- [AEO Definition - What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?](https://techterms.com/definition/aeo): Definition of Answer Engine Optimization for AI search and AI Overviews

## Security & Infrastructure

- [CVE Definition - What are Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures?](https://techterms.com/definition/cve): Explanation of CVE security standard for vulnerability identification and management
- [System Hardening Definition - What is system hardening?](https://techterms.com/definition/system_hardening): Explanation of system hardening techniques to minimize security vulnerabilities
- [IANA (Internet Assigned Numbers Authority) Definition](https://techterms.com/random): Definition of IANA and its role in Internet infrastructure and IP management
- [MSP Definition - What is a Managed Service Provider?](https://techterms.com/definition/msp): Definition of Managed Service Providers and IT services they offer businesses

## Hardware & Technology

- [Hyper-Threading Definition - What is hyper-threading technology?](https://techterms.com/definition/hyperthreading): Explanation of Intel's Hyper-Threading processor technology for multithreading
- [WebP Definition - What is the WebP (weppy) image format?](https://techterms.com/definition/webp): Explanation of Google's WebP image format and compression technology
- [Kindle Definition](https://techterms.com/definition/kindle): Definition of Amazon's Kindle e-reader and tablet device with E Ink technology
- [DPI Definition - What does DPI measure?](https://techterms.com/definition/dpi): Definition of DPI (dots per inch) and its role in print image resolution

## Audio & Connectors

- [XLR Definition - What is an XLR connector?](https://techterms.com/definition/xlr): Definition of XLR connectors for balanced audio and microphone cables
- [TRS Definition - What is a TRS audio jack?](https://techterms.com/definition/trs): Explanation of TRS audio connectors and comparison to XLR standards

## Systems & User Management

- [User Account Definition - What is a user account?](https://techterms.com/definition/user_account): Definition of user accounts and permissions on operating systems like macOS
